title: the Console Session writes reach the real engine through a durable pending-write record
committed_note: the candidate is not committed yet; the unit commits, the gate, the review, the merge and the push are still open. Until then every number below is a working-tree measurement, not a frozen candidate receipt.
gate_status_note: This unit ADDS the gate. It stays partial because the Session and notification projection is L10, session.create/session.open stay typed unsupported, and this is source-tree evidence with no installed-copy, restart, deployed-entrypoint or cross-device receipt.
governing_decision: the recorded 2026-10-14 connection.connect decision: the agent daemon reacts on its own, the control daemon only writes durable intent, and no control-to-agent channel and no Console relay are added. A4 records the two rejected candidates so the choice stays auditable.

verification.gate_command: pnpm exec vitest run --no-file-parallelism config/session-intent-store.spec.ts runtime/session-intent-watch.spec.ts runtime/control-process.spec.ts agent-host/acp-host.spec.ts
verification.full_regression: scripts/regression.mjs exit 1 on this candidate AND on unmodified base origin/main d531d24; the three failures differ between the two runs and the shared one has the same root cause on the base. Not claimed as a pass and not claimed as a regression of this unit; see notes.md section 9.
verification.pnpm_verify: not run. It is the pre-existing BLOCKED baseline (PROJECT_SDK_VERSION_PIN_MISMATCH:0.1.0014), so it is not a regression conclusion for this unit.

acceptance_items: the three frozen Session writes (permission.reply, session.cancel and the dedicated Session body ingress) perform one durable CAS write instead of refusing UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION, and the result reports only the accepted revision and never a Session state
an undeclared agentId is refused typed FORBIDDEN before any write, so the record path is never guessed
session.create and session.open stay typed UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION, because both must return real engine data and a one-way record cannot carry a response

the record has exactly one CAS fence: a stale expectation is REVISION_CONFLICT with the bytes untouched, a failed rename is uncertain with a real fence, and a malformed record is a typed throw never silently repaired
the reader keeps its own consumed watermark in its own data directory and reports the honest behind refusal instead of skipping a write the window already dropped
the watch applies in revision order and stops at the first write it cannot apply, so order is preserved and no write is silently skipped
permission.reply reaches the engine as a JSON-RPC response to the engine's own pending callback and selects only an optionId the engine really offered
the Console body reaches the engine verbatim as session/prompt, and session.cancel makes the daemon's own prompt end with stopReason cancelled
gaps: the control daemon still reports sessions: [] and notifications: [], so the Console sees neither the Session it writes to nor a permission identity from the projection; that projection is L10 and is not delivered here
session.create and session.open stay typed UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION and are deliberately not delivered

source-tree evidence only: the black box starts from the source CLI entry (the worktree generated/runtime-lib), not from an installed artifact, and there is no restart, deployed-entrypoint, cross-device or multi-account receipt
the engine is a local OpenAI-compatible stub provider, not an upstream model, so this proves that the write really reaches and is accepted by an engine, not any model quality
findings: cli/package-install.spec.ts is skipped on an uncommitted candidate by design: scripts/receipt-identity.mjs refuses a working tree with untracked product paths, so that gate runs only after integration

scripts/regression.mjs does not pass --no-file-parallelism, and both cli/agentteams.spec.ts and cli/package-install.spec.ts rebuild generated/runtime-lib in their beforeAll, so the CLI direct-entry test can fail from a concurrent rebuild; it passes 3/3 in isolation and 33/33 in its own file
findings_note: Both findings are pre-existing and are reproduced on the unmodified base d531d24. Neither is fixed in this unit, because neither is this unit's defect.

observed_values.gate_run_totals: the six gate commands measured 58 + 103 + 68 + 137 + 69 + 66 + 70 = 571 passing tests in total; that sum double counts shared spec files (agent-host/acp-host, runtime/control-process and runtime/acp-serve appear in more than one gate command), so it is a run total and not a distinct test count

non_claims: no installed-copy, restart, deployed-entrypoint, cross-device or multi-account evidence is claimed
no Session or notification projection, and no Console-visible permission identity, is claimed
no model quality or inference correctness is claimed
the full regression exit 1 is not claimed as a pass and not claimed as this unit's regression
